title: Define conformance assessment dimensions, evidence and results
requirements:
- Avoid an undifferentiated coverage percentage as the principal adoption measure; report by layer, capability and criticality
- Replace the 'left implicit' verdict with an explicit, persistent assessment-result model
- Tie 'correctly realises' to normative requirements, test assertions and accepted evidence
- Report structural, semantic, behavioural, security and interface conformance separately
- Break 'conformance of the architecture' into model validity, reference alignment, coverage, traceability and documented deviation, with expected evidence
- Add objectively checkable governance criteria (designated operator, multi-year plan, published performance, transfer plan, dispute route)
- Report mandatory/critical failures separately rather than averaging them away
- Specify minimum fields: status values, scope, assessor/mechanism, specification and version, evidence, date, validity
